title: Kickoff doesn't have a widget-specific shortcut set, and its config window doesn't mention its KWin-provided shortcut, which confuses people
line: An application launcher's Keyboard Shortcuts page now shows the global shortcut that opens it (Meta, Alt+F1 by default), kept up to date, with a button to change it.
explanation: Meta and Alt+F1 open the launcher through plasmashell's global "Activate Application Launcher" shortcut, which picks the launcher on the active screen, so the widget's own shortcut stays unset and its Keyboard Shortcuts page only said "None". Users then tried to set Meta there and got a conflict warning. The shell (ShellCorona, which owns that action) now has a launcherShortcuts property: the action's shortcuts from KGlobalAccel as native text, re-emitted when KGlobalAccel::globalShortcutChanged reports a change to it. For widgets that provide org.kde.plasma.launchermenu (Kickoff, Kicker, Dashboard), the Shortcuts page shows that property under the action's name, with a short explanation and a "Configure Global Shortcut…" button that opens System Settings at Plasma Workspace's shortcuts.

commits.message:
shell: expose the launcher's global shortcut to QML

Launcher settings want to show the shortcuts of the shell's own Activate
Application Launcher action. Add a property with them as display text,
updated whenever KGlobalAccel reports a change to the action's shortcut.

BUG: 510769

desktoppackage: show the global launcher shortcut on the Shortcuts page

Launchers open with the global Activate Application Launcher shortcut,
but their Keyboard Shortcuts page only showed "None". The page now shows
that shortcut as the shell reports it, explains it, and links to it.

BUG: 510769

patches.diff:
From 07eb6590a2e5fd45ba3a2b7283a97bdb31572439 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 21:43:27 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] desktoppackage: show the global launcher shortcut on the
 Shortcuts page

Launchers open with the global Activate Application Launcher shortcut,
but their Keyboard Shortcuts page only showed "None". The page now shows
that shortcut as the shell reports it, explains it, and links to it.

BUG: 510769
---
 .../configuration/ConfigurationShortcuts.qml  | 37 +++++++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 37 insertions(+)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/ConfigurationShortcuts.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/ConfigurationShortcuts.qml
index cb15923aaf..d4f628fcfa 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/ConfigurationShortcuts.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/ConfigurationShortcuts.qml
@@ -5,6 +5,8 @@
 */
 
 import QtQuick
+import QtQuick.Controls as QQC2
+import QtQuick.Layouts
 import org.kde.kquickcontrols
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
@@ -17,6 +19,11 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
 
     property bool unsavedChanges: false
 
+    // Launchers can also be opened by plasmashell's own global shortcut, which opens the one on the active screen
+    readonly property QtObject launcherAction: (Plasmoid.metaData.rawData["X-Plasma-Provides"] ?? []).includes("org.kde.plasma.launchermenu")
+        ? Plasmoid.containment.corona.action("activate application launcher") : null
+    readonly property list<string> launcherShortcuts: launcherAction ? Plasmoid.containment.corona.launcherShortcuts : []
+
     function saveConfig() {
         Plasmoid.globalShortcut = button.keySequence
         unsavedChanges = false
@@ -31,5 +38,35 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
             patterns: ShortcutPattern.Modifier | ShortcutPattern.ModifierAndKey
             onKeySequenceModified: root.unsavedChanges = keySequence !== Plasmoid.globalShortcut
         }
+
+        Item {
+            Kirigami.FormData.isSection: true
+            visible: root.launcherAction !== null
+        }
+
+        QQC2.Label {
+            Kirigami.FormData.label: root.launcherAction ? i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "@label %1 is the name of a global shortcut", "%1:", root.launcherAction.text) : ""
+            visible: root.launcherAction !== null
+            text: root.launcherShortcuts.length > 0
+                ? root.launcherShortcuts.join(i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "@info separator between keyboard shortcuts", ", "))
+                : i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "@info no keyboard shortcut", "None")
+        }
+
+        QQC2.Label {
+            Layout.fillWidth: true
+            Layout.maximumWidth: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 20
+            visible: root.launcherAction !== null
+            text: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "@info", "This global shortcut opens the launcher on the active screen. The shortcut above opens this launcher only.")
+            textFormat: Text.PlainText
+            wrapMode: Text.Wrap
+            font: Kirigami.Theme.smallFont
+        }
+
+        QQC2.Button {
+            visible: root.launcherAction !== null
+            icon.name: "preferences-desktop-keyboard-shortcut"
+            text: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "@action:button", "Configure Global Shortcut…")
+            onClicked: KCM.KCMLauncher.openSystemSettings("kcm_keys", "plasmashell")
+        }
     }
 }
--

media.caption: Kickoff > Configure > Keyboard Shortcuts on master: only "None", nothing about Meta
Same page with the fix: "Activate Application Launcher: Meta, Alt+F1", what it does, and a button to configure it
Master: the page has no line for the global shortcut, so nothing reflects changes to it
With the fix, the window stays open and focused while the global shortcut is changed to Meta and back: the line follows at once

review.text: Well-architected two-repo fix that exposes the shell's global Activate Application Launcher shortcuts directly from ShellCorona via KGlobalAccel's local cache and globalShortcutChanged signal (avoiding blocking D-Bus calls) and displays them read-only with a short explanation and a System Settings button on the Shortcuts page for org.kde.plasma.launchermenu widgets. It avoids D-Bus interface churn, degrades safely in coronas without that action, and uses proper i18ndc domains. Screenshots and video convincingly confirm both the UI and live updates when the global shortcut changes.
